icons.effect: 0.5U holy spell; establish prepared Remedy after contact. Replacement never converts prepared into full.

icons.effect: 1.1U holy spell. Consume Remedy for next-action Exposed, full or prepared; a full Remedy also clears one eligible self-debuff. No new Remedy is created.

icons.effect: 1.5U holy spell. Consume Remedy for +0.3U full / +0.15U prepared direct power, or 10% full / 6% prepared Ward instead. Available from third H.

icons.effect: Heal 5% HP. Consume Debt for 8% instead; forfeit collection damage.

icons.effect: Attack may pay one Writ and consume opening Debt for its fixed derived payout capped 0.3U, or keep it and gain +15% direct Attack damage. Derived payouts do not record or crit.

icons.effect: 1.1U physical arrow. If opening Chill exists, ignore 30% armour without consuming it; otherwise apply one-F Pin instead.

icons.effect: Attack may pay one Rime and consume one opening Chill for 8% Ward after contact, or retain Chill and pay one Rime for one-F Weaken. No second arrow or same-action refund.

icons.effect: 8% Ward and clear one eligible self-debuff. Optional consume Line for 12% Ward instead of cleansing; no Line re-priming.

icons.effect: 0.6U holy-electric spell; gain one Charge after contact. With reserve opening at least three, choose two-F Mark instead of that gain.

icons.effect: 10% Ward and clear one eligible self-debuff. Never earns Charge from prevented damage or blocked statuses.
